2700890.title: Secondary Communication Failover Method
2700890.custom_preface: To verify the platform validator continues to operate when the ethernet network fails and moves over to cellular
2700890.custom_preconds:
**GIVEN** the ethernet is disconnected from the platform validator and is running on cellular
**AND** the user has a valid smartcard available
**AND** the platform validator is on a NIR route

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** the user presents the smartcard to the platform validator card reader
custom_steps_seperated.expected: **THEN** the 'Validation Success' screen is displayed

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** the user removes the smartcard from the platform validator card reader
custom_steps_seperated.expected: **THEN** the 'Home Screen' is displayed

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity logs are checked
custom_steps_seperated.expected: **THEN** the transaction can be identified

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** reviewing the data in Smartrack
custom_steps_seperated.expected: **THEN** the transaction can be identified

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** reviewing the data in Merit
custom_steps_seperated.expected: **THEN** the transaction can be identified

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** reviewing data in Merit Web Reporter
custom_steps_seperated.expected: **THEN** the transaction can be identified

2700890.custom_expected: **THEN** the platform validator continues to operate as normal

4073875.title: FEIG Update Fails if Device Group Lacks TID/TK, but PV App Software Still Updates
4073875.custom_preconds:
**GIVEN** A device group for the selected PV Device and FEIG Device is created and configured in CloudFare
**AND** The device group lacks a TID and TK
**AND** A PV and FEIG dataset is created in CloudFare
**AND** the PV dataset includes a new application software version (e.g. cEMVcapablebuild.zip)
**AND** the FEIG dataset includes updates for Transparent App, PCA, and FEIG OS
**AND** the PV devices in the group are missing valid TerminalId and TransactionKey values

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** The full dataset (PV + FEIG) is deployed to the device group via TMS
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** The PV application software should be successfully updated
**BUT** The FEIG firmware update should fail due to missing TerminalId and TransactionKey
**AND** The new software version should be visible in CloudFare
**AND** The FEIG devices should remain on their previous version
**AND** A failure status or exception should be logged in CloudFare for the FEIG update

4091911.title: TIBU-27289 - No event for barcode reader dropouts
4091911.custom_preface:
Version: v3.1.2 (NIR)

Actual: Unlike the GV there is no event that triggers when there is a barcode reader dropout on the PV

Expected: An event should trigger when the barcode reader drops out (much like GV)

Steps:

Simulate a barcode reader dropout by disconnecting the barcode reader USB

Barcode functionality will not trigger any more

Actual Result:

Notice in Cloudfare how there is no event for the dropout

Expected Result:

Event code 941 should be raised and then when the barcode reader is able to be connected to again then the 941 event should be cleared
4091911.custom_preconds:
**GIVEN** the PV is In Service
**AND** a barcode reader is connected to the PV

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** the user disconnects the barcode reader from the PV
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** barcodes not available banner is displayed on the PV
**AND** the event for the barcode not available is displayed in Activity Log
